item.summary: fix(mantis): prove the PR merged onto current main instead of the raw head (#127961) The Telegram Desktop proof previously built the candidate from the raw PR head, so a head behind main failed for reasons main already fixed (observed on #127770: 59 commits behind, hitting the Unknown-model defect fixed by #127952). GitHub's cached PR test merge cannot be the candidate either: it was observed 50 commits / 12 hours stale and never refreshed. The workflow now resolves the live refs/heads/main tip and merge base at dispatch, requires a main-targeting PR, and builds a deterministic local merge (merge-tree --merge-base + commit-tree with pinned identity/date) as the candidate; conflicts fail with a direct rebase message and there is no fallback to the raw head. Lane labels and docs now say the candidate is the PR merged onto main.
